heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: 111 dead, 1,672 injured after M7.7 quake struck 68km NNW of Ende at 10km depth on 15 August; the toll held flat on Day 14 with no new fatalities. Displacement fell to 176,621 — down from a 185,131 peak on 25 August — as families began returning home. President Prabowo finally visited the disaster zone on 26 August, eleven days after the quake, distributing Rp200 billion in aid. BMKG has recorded 8,193+ aftershocks.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
